card.name: Word right after a topic noun
card.fires_on: A verb, noun or preposition placed right after a subject noun or acronym, where the next words give a cause, count or scope. Examples are 'calculated for', 'caused', 'causes', 'cases', 'insertion'.

modes.label: Cause words
modes.description: Forms of cause after a named condition or effect, leading into an explanation.
modes.example: IUGR has various<< causes>>. The most common cause is a problem

modes.label: Word after a condition name
modes.description: A noun or verb right after a disease or study term, such as cases, score or positivity.
modes.example: Tumor lysis syndrome (TLS)<< cases>> have been reported in nilotinib

modes.label: Verb or preposition after a topic
modes.description: A verb or preposition that leads into the scope or manner of something.
modes.example: It can be calculated<< for>> an activity, an individual, a family
